content.description: The calculator shows how much reward can be expected for Pools with different parameters and different settings of the Cardano network. The calculator also estimates how much variability in the return can be expected by running a Monte Carlo simulation What does the calculator do? Shows the expected annual return of a stake pool for the operator and the delegators.
